SS01.name: 星磷鱼
SS01.form: a slender diamond-sectioned body, a small pointed head, a large oblique mouth, crisply bevelled scale edges, a narrow caudal peduncle
SS01.fins: a long trailing dorsal crest, a translucent fan-shaped tail fin, slender filamentous pelvic fins
SS01.markings: a sparse line of luminous points along the flank, a single glowing patch behind the eye
SS01.colour: 深靛底、磷青点、星屑银辉

SS02.name: 陨铁鲷
SS02.form: a deep diamond-shaped body with crisp faceted plates, a short blunt snout, a small terminal mouth, a high arched back, a compact head
SS02.fins: a spined dorsal fin with even triangular peaks, a deeply forked tail fin
SS02.markings: a cluster of pitted craters along the upper flank, a single streak at the base of the tail
SS02.colour: 铁灰底、熔痕铜、暗紫高光

SS03.name: 真空鳐
SS03.form: a broad diamond-shaped disc, a wide wing-like pectoral margin with clean cut edges, a short tail, a pair of small cephalic horns, a slight forward sweep
SS03.fins: a slender whip-like tail with a low dorsal ridge, barely visible pelvic fins
SS03.markings: a clear unmarked gap across the disc centre, a fine rim line tracing the wing edge
SS03.colour: 墨蓝底、虚空留白、边缘银线

SS04.name: 深海星鳗
SS04.form: a ribbon-like body with a diamond cross-section, a slender tapering head, a small mouth, a row of minute luminous nodes down the midline
SS04.fins: a low continuous dorsal ridge merging with the tail fin, small rounded pectoral fins
SS04.markings: a single row of faint nodes along the flank, a break in the ridge behind the head
SS04.colour: 靛黑底、星芒银点、腹部微光

SS05.name: 冷光鮟鱇
SS05.form: a stout rounded body, a large head, a wide gaping mouth with small even teeth, a short lure stalk rising from the snout, loose matte skin
SS05.fins: a low dorsal fin, small rounded pectoral fins, a rounded tail fin
SS05.markings: a single luminous tip at the end of the lure, a faint spot behind the eye
SS05.colour: 冷灰底、幽蓝冷光、喉部暗影

SS06.name: 幽蓝水母
SS06.form: a shallow dome-shaped bell with evenly scalloped rim segments, four grouped trailing tentacle clusters, a short core stalk
SS06.markings: a ring of luminous points around the bell rim, faint radial seams on the dome
SS06.colour: 幽蓝底、冷银边缘、深空暗心

SS07.name: 陨尘鲳
SS07.form: a deep oval body, a small head, a short blunt snout, a small mouth, fine points fused into faceted scales
SS07.fins: a long low dorsal fin, a slightly forked tail fin, small pectoral fins
SS07.markings: a loose trail of tiny craters along the flank, a short streak near the gill cover
SS07.colour: 烟灰底、尘金微粒、暗铜高光

SS08.name: 暗星鲷
SS08.form: a deep compressed oval body, a steep forehead, a small mouth, a large eye, a row of recessed luminous pits along the back
SS08.fins: a spined dorsal fin with even triangular peaks, a slightly forked tail fin
SS08.markings: a cluster of luminous pits along the upper flank, a single band crossing the nape
SS08.colour: 墨黑底、内敛星点、冷银扣边

SS09.name: 星尘鳀
SS09.form: a slender spindle-shaped body, a pointed snout, a large mouth, a single fine line of glowing specks along the midline, a narrow caudal peduncle
SS09.fins: a short dorsal fin set far back, a deeply forked tail fin, small pectoral fins
SS09.markings: an even row of glowing specks along the midline, a faint spot at the tail base
SS09.colour: 浅靛底、星尘白点、银灰腹面

SS10.name: 陨砾鲹
SS10.form: a fusiform streamlined body with faceted flank plates, a small head, a blunt snout, a terminal mouth
SS10.fins: a long dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, a row of finlets behind the dorsal and anal fins
SS10.markings: a broken line of gravel-like nicks along the flank, a single notch above the pectoral base
SS10.colour: 砾褐底、陨灰斑块、冷铁反光
